name: @kasarlabs/mist-cash-mcp

tools.name: mist_cash_deposit
tools.description: Deposit tokens into a Mist Cash chamber for private transactions. Generates a claiming key that can be used to withdraw the funds later.

symbol.description: The token symbol to deposit (e.g., ETH, USDC, STRK)

amount.description: The amount to deposit in standard units (e.g., "1" for 1 USDC, "0.5" for 0.5 ETH)

claimingKey.description: Optional claiming key. If not provided, a random one will be generated

recipientAddress.description: The address that will be able to withdraw the funds

tools.name: mist_cash_get_chamber_info
tools.description: Get information about a chamber (deposited funds) using a claiming key and recipient address. Shows token, amount, and whether the transaction still exists in the merkle tree.

claimingKey.description: The claiming key used during deposit

recipientAddress.description: The recipient address that can withdraw

tools.name: mist_cash_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw tokens from a Mist Cash chamber using the claiming key. The tokens will be sent to the recipient address specified during deposit.

claimingKey.description: The claiming key used during deposit

recipientAddress.description: The recipient address that will receive the funds

symbol.description: The token symbol to withdraw (e.g., ETH, USDC, STRK)

amount.description: The amount to withdraw in standard units (e.g., "1" for 1 USDC, "0.5" for 0.5 ETH)
